metadata.project: Fringenuity Icon Matrix (FRINGE Twitter avatar campaigns, Seasons 4-5)
metadata.description: Per-image authorship for every artwork file under the unified icon matrix. Authors were gleaned from the artist-named sub-folders and the 'Image credits' lines of the iconmanager pages that displayed them.

confidence_levels.high: Artist folder explicitly names the artist (e.g. 'ATU-zort70', 'SP-FY').
confidence_levels.medium: Folder code matches an artist by naming pattern (e.g. 'gmmtp' = GoldenMonkey, 'sptp' = SarahProost).
confidence_levels.unresolved: Coded/anonymous or public 'upload' folder; specific artist not encoded. A candidate list of the campaign's credited artists is provided instead.

metadata.handles_note: Handles are transcribed exactly as printed on the 2012-2013 site files; no web verification was performed.
